page: Microsoft Azure D32pls_v6 is an ARM-based virtual machine configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores without simultaneous multithreading. Running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance is powered by custom Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processors operating at 3.4 GHz. The CPU architecture provides 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and a shared 128 MB L3 cache, with hardware-accelerated AES cryptography instructions enabled.

The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. No local disk storage is included, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data. There are no discrete GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

Benchmark evaluations reveal top-tier memory bandwidth, recording 449.06 GB/sec in large-block read operations and 188.51 GB/sec in write operations, paired with a top-decile PassMark database operations score. Multi-core compute performance ranks in the top 25% across stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and Clang compilation tests. Conversely, single-core CPU metrics and Redis SET throughput remain in the middle 50%, while large 70B parameter LLM inference prompt processing rates fall into the lower tiers.

Given its compute-heavy 1:2 core-to-memory density and high multi-core scaling, the D32pls_v6 is suited for multi-threaded compilation, software build pipelines, web serving clusters, and containerized microservices that benefit from high memory throughput without requiring expansive RAM allocations per thread.
description: Microsoft Azure D32pls_v6 is an arm64 virtual machine featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs and 32 physical cores running on 3.4 GHz Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processors under Microsoft Hyper-V. The system includes 64.0 GB of RAM (2.0 GB per core), 128 MB of L3 cache, and AES cryptographic acceleration, with no bundled local storage or GPUs. Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier uncached memory read bandwidth (449.06 GB/sec) and database operation throughput, alongside strong multi-core processing in stress-ng and Clang compilation benchmarks. Single-thread performance and large language model inference place in the average to lower tiers. With a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, D32pls_v6 is tailored for parallelized build environments, multi-threaded CPU tasks, and high-throughput web serving workloads that prioritize compute efficiency over massive memory footprint.
